instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, eye-level. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio with white walls and a light gray floor, two girls practice stretches. In the foreground, the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top and matching shorts (R5) kneels on her left knee with her right leg extended forward. Behind her to the right, the light brown-haired girl in a beige crop top and shorts (R2) kneels with her right leg extended backward. Both wear white socks and look forward in profile. The scene is illuminated by bright, diffused natural light from background windows, creating a soft, neutral-toned atmosphere.
